cards.title: Welcome to Spooky Diner
cards.text: Chef here! The grill is hot and the first guests are drifting in. They are a little see-through, but they tip just fine. Serve them fast!

cards.title: Word gets around
cards.text: Ghosts all over town are talking about your fries. Keep the orders quick and the line will only get longer.

cards.title: The oven is lit
cards.text: Dough, oven, plate, done. Pizza is on the menu now. Keep an eye on it so it does not burn, chef. Nobody wants an angry ghost.

cards.title: Sous Chef
cards.text: You run this kitchen like a pro. A full counter of hungry ghosts is no trouble for you.

cards.title: Head Chef
cards.text: VIP spirits are dropping by, and they tip big for fast service. Keep that combo going!

cards.title: Kitchen Boss
cards.text: From one little fryer to a full kitchen. Every ghost on the street knows Spooky Diner now.
